summary: The Kenilworth Artists Association is a standing neighborhood artists' association in Asheville's Kenilworth neighborhood that runs an annual self-guided studio tour of 27 member artists. It maintains its own website with a yearly artist roster, volunteer coordination, and sponsorship pages, and donates 5% of tour sales to a fixed charity partner (Loving Food Resources) each year, indicating an organization that persists beyond a single event rather than a one-off tour brand.

evidence.note: Listing describes 27 named Kenilworth artists showing work together and points to KenilworthArtists.org for the tour map, implying an organized association rather than an ad-hoc gathering.

Association's own site has standing infrastructure (registration, volunteer sign-up, sponsor management) and a '2026 Artists' roster page, suggesting recurring yearly participation rather than a single event.

About page frames the group as 'an artistic community' of the Kenilworth neighborhood and notes artists donate 5% of tour sales to Loving Food Resources every year, a recurring commitment beyond the event itself.
No governance details, founding date, or membership process were published on the site, so it is unclear how formal the association's structure is beyond the artist roster and shared branding.
